description.value: A fine crystalline-looking growth that lives in the brine film of the evaporite pans and turns from colourless to deep red over the four days after a flood. Harvested at the red stage and ground, it gives the only fast dye on the planet, which is used on cloth, on the dead and on the boundary stones of a water claim. Left past the fifth day it whitens again and is worthless, which sets the working week of an entire industry.

notes.value: The dye is fugitive in ultraviolet and holds for about a season outdoors. Nobody on the planet regards this as a defect, and one field report has been quietly withdrawn for saying so.
